description: Replace the owner's seat rules. Each rule is keyed by a format (dolby, imax, prime, laser, digital, 3d, other) or one auditorium written theatreId:auditorium (theatreId from find_theatres; auditorium as the showing lists it, for example 2152:Auditorium 12), and holds ordered seats like G11 or a free-text sentence. This replaces every rule: start from get_plan prefs.seatRules and pass the full set; {} clears them. Rules are only copied into a booking request an executor queues; they never affect ranking, book anything or reserve a seat. Ask the human for their own seats; never infer them.
name: set_seat_preferences
title: Set planner seat preferences
